jobs.title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the future of authentication? Join 1Kosmos and help lead the next wave in identity assurance and passwordless innovation.

1Kosmos is driving the future of identity security, empowering organizations to eliminate passwords and establish trust at every step of the identity lifecycle. As a vibrant team of innovators, we develop advanced authentication solutions trusted by some of the world’s leading brands. Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance.

We are looking for an AI / Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and deploy advanced computer vision and AI solutions. You will work on projects involving image capture, data extraction, and fraud detection, delivering high-performance models that can run on both mobile devices and cloud environments.

This role blends R&D with production engineering—you’ll take ownership of the full ML lifecycle, from dataset creation and model training to deployment and performance optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement AI models for image classification, object detection, OCR, and feature extraction.
  • Develop real-time image quality assessment and capture guidance algorithms.
  • Create and maintain data pipelines for collecting, cleaning, augmenting, and labeling datasets.
  • Implement model optimization techniques for mobile (on-device) and cloud inference.
  • Apply fraud detection methods to identify tampering, forgeries, or replay attacks in visual data.
  • Integrate ML models into production-grade APIs and mobile SDKs.
  • Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to align AI capabilities with business goals.

 

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 3+ years of experience building and deploying ML models in production.
  • Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar).
  • Experience with computer vision libraries (e.g., OpenCV) and OCR technologies.
  • Strong understanding of deep learning architectures for image and text recognition.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and API development.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in fast-paced environments.
  • Based in the NJ / NY area; Hybrid working model.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with model quantization and optimization for mobile deployment.
  • Knowledge of synthetic data generation and data augmentation techniques.
  • Background in security, liveness detection, or anomaly detection.
  • Exposure to compliance and data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or published research.

Benefits

  • Cutting-Edge Tech Stack: Build with decentralized identity protocols, FedRamp High, FIDO2-certified cryptography, and NIST-compliant biometric systems. 
  • Accelerated Growth: Receive annual stipends for certifications and attend key conferences like Identiverse or EIC.
  • Ownership & Impact: We move fast and will enable you to make a big impact with large customers in US & Canada. 
  • Flexibility First: Unlimited PTO, and 2 days WFH

jobs.title: BDR Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Business Development Manager to build, hire, and scale our frontline outbound engine. 

You will have direct ownership over building the team from the ground up: recruiting top talent, designing repeatable prospecting playbooks, and taking full end-to-end accountability for the performance, metrics, and ROI of the entire program. 

This includes coaching such as running live call-coaching sessions, refining messaging, holding reps accountable to rigorous performance metrics, and partnering closely with Marketing and Executive Leadership to turn high-value target accounts into qualified enterprise pipeline. 

What You’ll Do:

Function Building & Talent Acquisition 

  • Build and Scale the Team: Lead the BDR talent strategy from day one: recruiting, interviewing, and hiring high-caliber, resilient BDRs based out of our NJ headquarters. 
  • Onboarding and Enablement: Build structured, repeatable training programs that accelerate rep ramp times to full quota productivity. 
  • Architect the Outbound Infrastructure: Establish core operating procedures, multi-touch sequence playbooks, call scripts, and objection-handling guides tailored to technical enterprise buyers. 

Frontline Coaching & Skill Development 

  • In-the-Trenches Mentorship: Conduct weekly live call-coaching sessions, call recording audits (e.g., via Gong), and email messaging reviews. 
  • Technical Buyer Alignment: Teach reps how to navigate complex enterprise deals and hold high-value conversations with technical buyers. 
  • Career Pathing: Establish clear performance benchmarks and growth tracks, preparing top-performing BDRs for future roles within the organization. 

Operational Rigor & Program Accountability 

  • Own the Outbound Pipeline Number: Take complete accountability for meeting and exceeding monthly and quarterly Sales Accepted Opportunity targets. 
  • Metrics & Funnel Optimization: Track and analyze key performance indicators to continually optimize program ROI. 
  • Pipeline Hygiene & Qualification: Enforce strict qualification frameworks (e.g. BANT) and CRM discipline to ensure high-quality handoffs to Account Executives. 

Cross-Functional GTM Strategy 

  • Marketing & ABM Alignment: Partner closely with Marketing to align outbound plays with active marketing campaigns and target account lists. 
  • AE Feedback Loops: Establish tight alignment with Enterprise Account Executives to ensure smooth account handoffs, territory optimization, and strategic multi-threading. 

Requirements

What We’re Looking For 

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience building, managing, or leading a BDR/SDR team in an enterprise B2B SaaS environment.  
  • Track Record as a Builder: Demonstrated success recruiting top sales talent, scaling a team, and taking complete ownership of pipeline goals. 
  • Data-Driven & Accountable:  Able to diagnose funnel bottlenecks, iterate on playbooks, and optimize activity-to-pipeline conversion rates. 
  • Technical Aptitude: Ability to grasp complex technical architectures and translate technical features into clear, business-driven value propositions. 
  • Leadership Style: High-accountability leader who leads by example, builds a collaborative and competitive team culture, and holds reps to high standards. 

 

Benefits

Flexible Hybrid Work Model / Medical / Dental / Vision / 401k

jobs.title: Channel Manager - India
jobs.description:
Job Purpose / Summary

The Channel Manager will be responsible for developing, enabling, and managing 1Kosmos’ ecosystem of distributors, resellers, and system integrators across India. The role requires building trusted relationships with partner executives, driving joint go-tomarket strategies, and ensuring that partners generate measurable pipelines, bookings, and customer success in both the commercial and public sector. This position will also involve close collaboration with internal sales, marketing, pre-sales, and customer success teams to accelerate partner-led revenue.

Location India (Mumbai / Bangalore preferred). Frequent travel to partner offices, distributors, and customer meetings across the country

Key Responsibilities

• Channel Strategy & Planning o Develop and execute a channel business plan aligned with 1Kosmos’ India growth targets. Potential to expand across Middle East-Africa (MEA) and South East Asia.

o Segment partners (distributors, resellers, SIs) by potential and build tiered engagement/enablement models.

o Ensure public sector distribution partners are fully compliant with government procurement/tender requirements.

• Partner Recruitment & Onboarding o Identify and recruit high-potential partners to expand 1Kosmos’ coverage in India.

o Drive onboarding programs including product training, sales/technical enablement, and joint account planning.

• Pipeline Development & Co-Selling o Work with partners to develop joint pipelines through account mapping, lead sharing, and marketing campaigns.

o Support partners in driving opportunities, RFP responses, and proof-ofconcepts with Seclore resources.

o Track and manage partner-sourced vs. partner-influenced pipeline in CRM, ensuring accurate forecasting.

• Enablement & Incentives

o Deliver regular partner training sessions (sales and technical).

o Design incentive structures to drive deal registrations, certifications, and revenue attainment.

o Run quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with key partners to align on goals and track progress.

• Execution & Governance o Enforce 1Kosmos’ channel policies, including deal registration, pricing, and compliance guidelines. o Monitor distributor stock, credit, and order fulfillment cycles.

o Ensure marketing development funds (MDF) and partner campaigns are well utilized with measurable ROI.

Requirements

• 6–10 years of experience in enterprise IT/security sales with at least 4+ years in channel management in India.

• Strong relationships with major Indian distributors, SIs, and resellers.

• Demonstrated success in building and executing joint GTM strategies with partners.

• Familiarity with government/public sector distribution models, tender processes, and compliance frameworks.

• Strong negotiation and conflict resolution skills.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with ability to influence senior partner executives.

• Proficiency with Hubspot (or other CRM), partner portals, and partner marketing tools.

Preferred / Nice to Have

• Previous experience at security vendors such as Okta, SailPoint, Juniper, Palo Alto, Cisco, etc.

• Exposure to both commercial enterprise and regulated public sector environments. • Understanding of Indian data protection, privacy, and compliance regulations.

• Ability to manage multi-tier distribution Performance Metrics / KPIs

• Channel-sourced and channel-influenced revenue attainment.

• Number and quality of active certified partners.

• Pipeline creation through partners (new logos + expansion).

• Partner satisfaction and retention rates.

• MDF utilization ROI and partner marketing effectiveness.

• QBR performance metrics (deal reg, certification growth, forecast accuracy).

Benefits

• Competitive base salary + performance-based variable compensation.

• Health benefits in line with 1Kosmos policy.

• Professional growth opportunities, training, and regional exposur

jobs.title: Channel Partner Program Manager
jobs.description:
Role Overview

 

1Kosmos is seeking a Channel Partner Program Manager to help scale and operationalize its global partner ecosystem. This role will focus on building, enabling, and expanding partner relationships across key channels including Global Systems Integrators (GSIs), Technology Alliances, Managed Service Providers (MSPs/MSSPs), Value-Added Resellers (VARs), and Cloud Hyperscalers.

 

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how enterprise software is bought and implemented through partners and who can turn strategy into execution. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure partners are enabled, active, and driving real pipeline and revenue globally.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Partner Recruitment, Development and Expansion

  • Support the execution of 1Kosmos’s global partner strategy across five core partner types:
    • Global Systems Integrators (GSIs)
    • Technology Alliances (ISVs)
    • Managed Service Providers and MSSPs
    • Value-Added Resellers (VARs)
    • Cloud Hyperscalers including AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI
  • Lay the web based and communications processes to identify, recruit, and onboard new partners in priority regions including North America, EMEA (ME priority), and APAC
  • Help expand existing partner relationships through knowledge transfer programs driving deeper technical alignment, co-selling, and joint go-to-market initiatives

 

Partner Enablement and Operations

  • Build and maintain partner enablement assets including web-based tools and collateral, pitch decks, use cases, demo access, and integration guides
  • Coordinate partner onboarding, training sessions, and certifications
  • Support deal registration, co-sell motions, and marketplace-driven transactions where applicable
  • Ensure partners are equipped to position, sell, and deliver 1Kosmos solutions effectively via the 1Kosmos Learning Academy

 

Go-to-Market and Co-Sell Execution

  • Work with MSSP’s, high level VAR’s, Technology Alliance partners and GSIs to support co-sell motions and joint account planning
  • Assist in launching joint solution offerings, integrations, and partner-led campaigns
  • Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and help drive deal progression

 

Program Management and Reporting

  • Maintain partner tracking, prioritization, and performance reporting including partner pipeline, enablement status, and priorities
  • Help define partner tiers, incentives, and engagement models over time
  • Work closely with VP Partnerships, SVP Sales, Finance, and Sales Ops to implement appropriate reporting and tooling
  • Provide regular updates to the VP of Partnerships on progress, risks, and opportunities

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales to align on account strategy and partner engagement
  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering on integration priorities and partner technical needs
  • Work with Marketing on partner-facing content, marketplace listings, and joint knowledge transfer campaigns

 

What Success Looks Like

  • Partners are actively engaged, enabled, and bringing 1Kosmos into deals
  • Clear progress across priority partners in each of the five partner categories
  • Increased partner-sourced and partner-assisted pipeline
  • A strong foundation in place for global scale and repeatable partner motions

Requirements

Qualifications

 

  • 5 to 8 or more years of experience in channel partnerships, alliances, or partner programs in enterprise software, cybersecurity, identity, or cloud
  • Experience working with one or more of the following partner types:
    • Global Systems Integrators such as Deloitte, EY, Accenture, or RSM
    • MSSP’s, MSP and high-end VARs
    • Security or identity technology partners such as Okta, Ping, or ServiceNow
  • Strong understanding of enterprise buying motions and partner-led go-to-market
  • Comfort operating in a fast-growing environment with evolving processes
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Experience supporting international partners or global expansion strongly preferred

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud marketplaces and co-sell programs such as AWS ISV Accelerate or Azure IP Co-sell
  • Background in identity, access management, digital identity, or Zero Trust
  • Prior experience building or scaling partner programs at an early or mid-stage company

Why 1Kosmos

  • Mission-driven company redefining digital identity and password less authentication
  • Opportunity to help build and shape a global partner ecosystem from the ground up
  • Direct exposure to executive leadership with meaningful impact in a fast-growing and critical market

Benefits

Flexible WFH model / Medical / Dental / Vision / 401k / Unlimited PTO
